tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the research-notebook paper. Every other colour is checked against it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table cells and inputs that sit on paper. Separated from paper by hairline, never by shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on paper, paper-raised, sage, grey-tint, ochre-tint and plum-tint (all 10.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, dates, helper text and secondary labels on paper, paper-raised and grey-tint (5.8:1 or better in both themes). Never for the five evidence-state words.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules and card edges only (1.5:1). Anything that carries meaning uses border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on buttons, chips, inputs and checkboxes, and the outline of selected rows (at least 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ironbark
tokens.usage: The brand colour: links, evidence references, the prerequisite-map rail, and the Suggested next step label. Text on paper and paper-raised (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-ironbark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ironbark fill (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ironbark-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for the Suggested next step label and for the selected prerequisite node; ironbark text reads on it at 6.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action per view and of the active starter task. A tint of the eucalyptus leaf; ink reads on it at 9.6:1 or better. It is never a success or eligibility signal.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Needs a current check: label text and clock icon on paper and ochre-tint (4.9:1 or better). Also the focus ring (solid, 2px, 5.3:1 or better on paper and paper-raised).

tokens.name: ochre-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for the Needs a current check label and for the historical-only limit panel.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Sources disagree: label text and icon on paper and plum-tint (6.4:1 or better). Chosen so disagreement is never confused with the ochre check state or the ironbark suggestion state by hue or lightness.

tokens.name: plum-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for the Sources disagree label and the conflicting-claims panel.

tokens.name: grey-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Outside current coverage, unknown table cells, disabled controls and the static source directory. ink and ink-muted read on it at 5.8:1 or better.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page title on the journey workspace and the cover. Fraunces at opsz 72 if the browser supports it.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card titles for the next-step card and limit panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ask your university contact before chasing a named program.
styles.usage: Body copy. 17px because founders read this on phones; never below 16px for running text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy; clarification questions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The five evidence-state labels, chip labels and button text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, publishers and helper text in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Corpus versions, request IDs, as-of dates and credential mode in the coverage banner.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between table cells' content and edge, label padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider screens; space between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the journey workspace.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top margin of the workspace and the prerequisite map's row pitch.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Evidence-state labels, table cells, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Context chips and the prerequisite-map nodes.
